name: CaseColorRgbaAlpha
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "color-rgba-alpha" (color). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: background-color: rgba(25, 118, 210, 0.5)
